name: RunPod
tagline: RunPod is a GPU cloud marketplace that offers on-demand and spot GPU instances for AI training, fine-tuning, and inference at competitive prices. Developers and researchers use it to run Stable Diffusion, LLaMA, and other open-source models without the cost of hyperscaler GPU reservations.
